description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Node_Comment which represents comment nodes in an HTML document as part of an HTML purification library. It includes properties for comment data and whitespace status, and methods for construction and token conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node_Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment node in an HTML document with methods for handling comment data and token conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a comment node with data, line, and column positions.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the comment node into a token pair suitable for HTML tokenization.
